hunks.baseline: What the hell kind of quest was this? The Quest Grade had even been replaced with question marks.
hunks.sol: Just look at this damn quest. Even its Grade was nothing but question marks.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, it’s sweet. Just as you’d expect from one that’s grown for fifty years.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, it’s sweet. Just what you’d expect from a fifty-year-old specimen.”

hunks.baseline: “Is it really reasonable to ask someone to bring you the Herb of Eternal Youth?”
hunks.sol: “Does asking someone to bring you the Herb of Eternal Youth sound remotely reasonable?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s been a long time since I met someone who cared about common sense in the Murim. There’s Hundred-Year Snow Ginseng, so why wouldn’t there be an Herb of Eternal Youth?”
hunks.sol: “It’s been a long time since I met someone who cared about common sense in the Murim. Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng exists, so why wouldn’t the Herb of Eternal Youth?”

hunks.baseline: I almost let myself be persuaded, but I quickly came to my senses. Somehow, I had to convince this old man who looked like even a needle couldn’t get through him.
hunks.sol: I almost let myself be persuaded, but quickly came to my senses. Somehow, I had to convince this old man who seemed impervious even to a needle.

hunks.baseline: “If there’s something else you need, I’ll get it for you. Anything you want. Just not something like the Herb of Eternal Youth.”
hunks.sol: “If there’s anything else you need, I’ll get it for you. Anything you want. Just not something like the Herb of Eternal Youth.”

hunks.baseline: “Hm. I’ve heard plenty about how impressive the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s influence has become these days.”
hunks.sol: “Hm. I’ve heard plenty about how formidable the Jin Family of Taiyuan has become these days.”

hunks.baseline: Jang Taebo nodded and opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Jang Taebo nodded.

hunks.baseline: “You said you wanted to make a weapon out of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, didn’t you? Then you’ll need a fine scabbard, too. I hear there’s a dragon at the end of the world. Pull out one of its claws and bring it back. And while you’re at it, bring me a dragon pearl, too.”
hunks.sol: “You said you wanted to make a weapon out of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, didn’t you? Then you’ll need a fine scabbard, too. I hear there’s a dragon at the end of the world. Pull out one of its claws and bring it back. And while you’re at it, bring me a dragon pearl.”

hunks.baseline: …Was I going to?
hunks.sol: …As if.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “I can hear you. You wet-behind-the-ears brat has a lot to say.”
hunks.sol: “I can hear you. You wet-behind-the-ears brat certainly have a lot to say.”

hunks.baseline: Just as Jang Taebo was waving a fist the size of a cast-iron pot, Cheongpung suddenly raised his hand and shouted,
hunks.sol: Just as Jang Taebo began waving a fist the size of a pot lid, Cheongpung thrust his hand into the air and shouted,

hunks.baseline: His eyes sparkled like morning stars, and his every gesture burned with enthusiasm. Jang Taebo flinched and took a step back from Cheongpung’s forcefulness.
hunks.sol: His eyes sparkled like morning stars, and his every gesture burned with enthusiasm. Faced with Cheongpung’s intensity, Jang Taebo flinched and took a step back.

hunks.baseline: As Jang Taebo shook his head from side to side, I casually added,
hunks.sol: As Jang Taebo shook his head, I casually added,

hunks.baseline: In the Murim, the Sword Saint Mae Jonghak’s very existence was an object of respect and awe.
hunks.sol: In the Murim, the Sword Saint Mae Jonghak’s very existence inspired respect and awe.

hunks.baseline: Jang Taebo stared at Cheongpung with clear surprise before opening his mouth.
hunks.sol: Jang Taebo stared at Cheongpung in evident surprise, then opened his mouth.

hunks.baseline: “I have nothing to do with Huashan. Well, I did make a sword at the request of the current Sect Leader of Huashan, Heavenly Sword True Person[^2], about thirty years ago. But that’s all.”
hunks.sol: “I have nothing to do with Huashan. Well, I did make a sword at the request of the current Sect Leader of Huashan, Heavenly Sword True Person,[^2] about thirty years ago. But that’s all.”

hunks.baseline: His firm voice continued.
hunks.sol: He continued firmly.

hunks.baseline: “I’m eighty years old. I’m still in good health, and I’ve accumulated plenty of wealth. As someone who has worked with iron, I can proudly say that I’m among the top three in the world.”
hunks.sol: “I’m eighty years old. I’m still in good health, and I’ve accumulated plenty of wealth. As a man who has worked iron all his life, I can proudly say that I rank among the top three in the world.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s why I’m refusing you. I’ve finished all the work I care to do. I’ve made swords until I’m sick of them.”
hunks.sol: “That’s why I’m refusing. I’ve done all the work I care to do. I’ve made enough swords to last me a lifetime.”

hunks.baseline: “If it’s a spear, it’ll require even more work. Swords are better.”
hunks.sol: “A spear would take even more work. I’d rather make a sword.”

hunks.baseline: I grabbed Jang Taebo’s hand with an earnest look.
hunks.sol: I grabbed Jang Taebo’s hand and gave him an earnest look.

hunks.baseline: “Couldn’t you think of it as a pastime after so long and help me just this once?”
hunks.sol: “Couldn’t you think of it as something to pass the time and help me just this once?”

hunks.baseline: “You just said you wouldn’t.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve been saying that this whole time.”

hunks.baseline: Jang Taebo roughly shook my hand away.
hunks.sol: Jang Taebo harshly shook off my hand.

hunks.baseline: “Bring me the gongcheong seokyu and dragon pearl while you’re at it. I hear that when fighting a dragon, you should avoid its tail, circle around behind it, and choke its neck. I’m telling you so you don’t get hurt.”
hunks.sol: “Bring me the gongcheong seokyu and dragon pearl while you’re at it. I hear that when fighting a dragon, you should avoid its tail, circle around behind it, and choke it. I’m telling you so you don’t get hurt.”

hunks.baseline: “Go on, spit it out.”
hunks.sol: “Go on. Spit it out.”

hunks.baseline: “Should I spread the word? That the former Guild Leader of the Ironcraft Guild lives here?”
hunks.sol: “Should I spread the word that the former Guild Leader of the Ironcraft Guild lives here?”

hunks.baseline: I was only saying that. Obviously, I had no intention of doing it.
hunks.sol: I was only saying it. Obviously, I had no intention of actually doing it.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t how it was supposed to go. Just as I was thinking that, Jang Taebo asked,
hunks.sol: This wasn’t how it was supposed to go. As I was thinking that, Jang Taebo asked,

hunks.baseline: “I’ll devote the rest of my life to making ten weapons. Then I’ll distribute those weapons, each made with all my heart and soul, to the leaders of the Nine Sects and One Gang, while having in-depth conversations with them about the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Your name will come up quite a lot, especially.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll devote the rest of my life to making ten weapons. Then I’ll distribute those weapons, each made with all my heart and soul, among the leaders of the Nine Sects and One Gang and have some in-depth conversations with them about the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Your name will come up quite often in particular.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll leave that to your imagination. Oh, and you do know that martial artists will stake their lives on their weapons regardless of the level of their martial arts, right? I’m sure they’ll be happy to grant a small request of mine.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll leave that to your imagination. Oh, and you do know that martial artists will stake their lives on their weapons regardless of how advanced their martial arts are, don’t you? I’m sure they’ll be happy to grant a small request of mine.”

hunks.baseline: It might be a small request to the leaders of the Nine Sects and One Gang, but it was anything but small to me or the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
hunks.sol: It might be a small request to the leaders of the Nine Sects and One Gang, but it would be anything but small to me or the Jin Family of Taiyuan.

hunks.baseline: As he turned to go into his room to pack, I grabbed his wrist. Jang Taebo asked innocently,
hunks.sol: As he turned to go into his room and pack, I grabbed his wrist. Jang Taebo asked innocently,

hunks.baseline: I lowered my head helplessly.
hunks.sol: I lowered my head in defeat.

hunks.baseline: “Please stop. I admit defeat.”
hunks.sol: “Please stop. I give up.”

hunks.baseline: I had defeated enemies stronger than me all this time, but I couldn’t break the will of an old man enjoying a quiet retirement.
hunks.sol: I had defeated enemies stronger than me time and again, but I couldn’t break the will of an old man enjoying a quiet retirement.

hunks.baseline: I was staring at the He Shou Wu Jang Taebo had half-chewed and abandoned, my spirits sinking, when he spoke.
hunks.sol: I was staring dejectedly at the half-chewed, discarded He Shou Wu when Jang Taebo spoke.

hunks.baseline: I hurriedly raised my head and saw Jang Taebo’s gruff face. He continued,
hunks.sol: I hurriedly raised my head to find Jang Taebo scowling at me. He continued,

hunks.baseline: “Do you think the Guild Leader has that much time on his hands? He’s busy, too. Someone of your standing will have to wait several years at the very least.”
hunks.sol: “Do you think the Guild Leader has that much time on his hands? He’s busy, too. Even someone like you would have to wait several years at the very least.”

hunks.baseline: “What, did you think a weapon could be completed overnight? He’s not as good as me, but he has some skill of his own, so obviously his orders are backed up. Even if he picks and chooses what to accept, it still takes that long.”
hunks.sol: “What, did you think a weapon could be completed overnight? He’s not as good as me, but he’s skilled enough that his orders are bound to be backed up. Even picking and choosing which ones to accept, it still takes that long.”

hunks.baseline: The unexpected long-term project left me short of breath.
hunks.sol: The prospect of such an unexpectedly long project left me short of breath.

hunks.baseline: “What do you mean, what do you do? I’ll write you a letter of introduction. Take it with you. You’ll be going there with a recommendation from his master, so he’ll probably do it a little sooner. That fellow can make one hell of a spear.”
hunks.sol: “What do you mean, what do you do? I’ll write you a letter of introduction. Take it with you. You’ll be going there with a recommendation from his master, so he’ll probably finish it a little sooner. That fellow makes one hell of a spear.”

hunks.baseline: “The village was in an uproar because of those mounted bandits, and I heard you were the one who dealt with them. I’ll do this for you as a special favor. Do you have paper, ink, and a brush?”
hunks.sol: “The village was in an uproar because of those mounted bandits, and I heard you were the one who dealt with them. I’ll do this for you as a special favor. Do you have paper, a brush, and ink?”

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. You don’t look like someone who carries them. Then you there…”
hunks.sol: “Right. One look at you, and I can tell you don’t carry such things. Then what about you…?”

hunks.baseline: He’s eating that now?
hunks.sol: *He’s eating those now?*

hunks.baseline: Jang Taebo sighed at the sight of Cheongpung stuffing the dumplings we had bought at the inn into his cheeks until they looked ready to burst.
hunks.sol: Jang Taebo sighed at the sight of Cheongpung stuffing the dumplings we had bought at the inn into his mouth until his cheeks looked ready to burst.

hunks.baseline: *When you’re old, you should just die. Young people these days have no manners.*
hunks.sol: “Old people should just die. Young people these days have no manners.”

hunks.baseline: Jang Taebo muttered loudly enough for us to hear and returned from inside with paper, ink, and a brush.
hunks.sol: Muttering loudly enough for us to hear, Jang Taebo went inside and returned with paper, a brush, and ink.

hunks.baseline: “First, the weapon is a spear… Do you have any thoughts about its shape or weight?”
hunks.sol: “First, the weapon is a spear… Do you have a particular shape or weight in mind?”

hunks.baseline: I began describing in detail the weight and shape that had become thoroughly familiar to me after using a spear for seven years.
hunks.sol: I described in detail the weight and shape that had become thoroughly familiar to me over seven years of wielding a spear.

hunks.baseline: Each time, Jang Taebo either nodded silently or added advice on how to make a spear better suited to me.
hunks.sol: As I spoke, Jang Taebo either nodded silently or offered advice on how to make the spear better suited to me.

hunks.baseline: He took a quick look over my body, then reeled off one correction after another. He somehow estimated the size of my hands and the length of my arms and legs, then adjusted the thickness and shape of the spear shaft little by little.
hunks.sol: He gave my body a quick once-over, then rattled off one correction after another. He gauged the size of my hands and the length of my arms and legs with uncanny accuracy, then adjusted the thickness and shape of the spear shaft little by little.

hunks.baseline: “Do you not have much? In my estimation, ten nyang should be enough to make something worthy of being called a renowned spear. It wouldn’t be embarrassing to pass down as a family heirloom.”
hunks.sol: “Do you not have much? By my estimate, ten nyang should be enough to produce something worthy of being called a renowned spear. You could pass it down as a family heirloom without shame.”

hunks.baseline: When I hesitated, Jang Taebo shouted,
hunks.sol: As I hesitated, Jang Taebo barked,

hunks.baseline: “Ah! How much of it are you going to put in?”
hunks.sol: “Ah! How much are you going to use?”

hunks.baseline: Seeing was believing. It would be faster to show him directly.
hunks.sol: Seeing was believing. It would be faster to show him.

hunks.baseline: I pretended to rummage through my travel bag and casually held out the Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron I had taken from my Inventory.
hunks.sol: Pretending to rummage through my travel bag, I took the Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron from my Inventory and casually held it out.

hunks.baseline: Jang Taebo didn’t answer. He stared intently at the Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, which was larger than an adult’s head, for a long time before asking in an intensely hoarse voice,
hunks.sol: Jang Taebo didn’t answer. He stared intently at the chunk of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, which was larger than a grown man’s head, for a long time before asking in a hoarse voice,

hunks.baseline: His wrinkled hands trembled faintly. Jang Taebo stroked the cold, bluish Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron as though he had been reunited with a child after sixty years. A sharp light flashed in his eyes.
hunks.sol: His wrinkled hands trembled faintly. Jang Taebo stroked the cold, blue-tinged Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron as though he had been reunited with a child after sixty years. A sharp light flashed in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: The old man who had found everything a nuisance was nowhere to be seen. His voice was brimming with passion and vitality.
hunks.sol: The old man who had found everything a nuisance was nowhere to be seen. His voice brimmed with passion and vitality.
